title: Crystal Skies Cobblemon
description: The official modpack of the Crystal Skies Cobblemon server.
body:
**The official modpack of the Crystal Skies Cobblemon server.**

This pack features Cobblemon 1.7.3 for Fabric Minecraft 1.21.1, as well as some other client side quality of life mods.

By default, this pack includes a conflicting keybind on the 'M' key being both the map opening button and the Cobblemon party button.
I've left rebinding it up to you, so that you KNOW where the keys are instead of guessing where I've put them.

**Mods include:**

Cobblemon
- The base of our server! Enjoy some Pokémon x Minecraft gameplay with friends new and old.

Sodium
- For performance.

Iris
- For if you'd like shaders, to make the game prettier.

Cobblemon Battle Extras
- Lets you see the information of your moves, how effective they are, information on your opponent and more while in battle!

Xaero's Minimap + World Map + Cobblemon Icons
- See the world around you and where nearby Cobblemon are!

EMI + JEI + Cobblemon Info for EMI
- Check up on recipes and the spawns of Cobblemon you're unfamiliar with at any time.

**This pack is compatiable with any pure Cobblemon 1.7.3 Fabric server.**

The Crystal Skies Cobblemon server features many server side mods, enabling Pokémon features that aren't in default Cobblemon including adding all 1025 Pokémon, TRs, Mega Evolution, Terastalisation, Z-Moves, Dynamax, and Gigantamax.

All YOU need to connect is the Cobblemon mod version 1.7.3, which is nicely packaged inside this reccomended modpack :)
